upgrade_roadmap.purpose: Curated list of open-source frameworks and agent tooling to study (or selectively adopt) when the research-harness outgrows its current hand-rolled pieces. Not installed — these are reference targets for future upgrades, kept here so an agent has a vetted shortlist and a clear 'borrow pattern X for component Y' mapping.

reference_frameworks.name: Ponytail
reference_frameworks.tagline: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room — the best code is the code you never wrote.
reference_frameworks.author: Dietrich Gebert
reference_frameworks.what_it_is: A rule/plugin pack that trains coding agents to write less, ship only what is needed, and mark any deliberate corner-cut with a `ponytail:` comment (greppable via `/ponytail-debt`). Ships as a plugin for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Devin, and others.
reference_frameworks.borrow_for: Discipline for future agent-driven changes to this repo: resist speculative features, keep the codebase lean, and tag simplifications that cut a corner with a known ceiling — a natural complement to the bugfix.json prevention rules.

reference_frameworks.name: Composio
reference_frameworks.tagline: 1000+ toolkits, tool search, context management, authentication, and a sandboxed workbench to build AI agents that turn intent into action.
reference_frameworks.author: ComposioHQ
reference_frameworks.what_it_is: A managed integration layer that gives agents 1000+ tools (GitHub, Google, Slack, search, etc.) with built-in auth management, tool search, and an MCP gateway plus a sandboxed workbench.
reference_frameworks.borrow_for: Replacing the harness's hand-rolled MCP preset catalog (src/harness/ui/routes_mcp.py + harness/mcp/) with a real, managed tool/connector catalog and managed OAuth — the obvious upgrade when the built-in fetcher/search aren't enough.

reference_frameworks.name: Chainlit
reference_frameworks.author: Chainlit (Literal AI)
reference_frameworks.what_it_is: Python framework for building chat interfaces with streaming, rich elements (charts, files, plots), multi-step flows, data layers, and auth.
reference_frameworks.borrow_for: Upgrading the web console (src/harness/ui/): token streaming to the chat, richer message types (tables/charts/elements), step/thinking visualization, and user authentication — patterns to mirror against the current hand-rolled renderer.
reference_frameworks.adopt_or_study: study (UX/streaming patterns), adopt only if replacing the console wholesale

reference_frameworks.name: Open WebUI
reference_frameworks.tagline: User-friendly AI Interface (Supports Ollama, OpenAI API, ...).
reference_frameworks.author: open-webui
reference_frameworks.what_it_is: Extensible self-hosted chat UI over Ollama/OpenAI-compatible endpoints with document RAG, function calling, multimodal support, multi-user management, and a plugin/pipelines system.
reference_frameworks.borrow_for: The harness's multi-model, multi-user, and document-RAG direction: model management, per-user sessions/keys, and a plugin/extension model — ideas for the AI Provider, Keys, and Sessions panels.

reference_frameworks.name: Agno
reference_frameworks.tagline: Build, run, and manage agent platforms.
reference_frameworks.author: agno-agi (formerly Phidata)
reference_frameworks.what_it_is: High-level Python agent framework with memory, knowledge (RAG), multi-modal input, agent teams, and a managed agent platform (AgentOS).
reference_frameworks.borrow_for: Upgrading the hand-rolled orchestration loop (src/harness/loop/): memory management, multi-step tool use, and agent-team/delegation patterns when the single-agent chat loop grows into multi-agent.

reference_frameworks.name: Semantic Kernel (Microsoft Agent Framework)
reference_frameworks.tagline: Integrate cutting-edge LLM technology quickly and easily into your apps.
reference_frameworks.author: Microsoft
reference_frameworks.what_it_is: Microsoft's SDK for integrating LLMs with code: plugins/functions, planners, memory, and multi-agent orchestration. Its successor, Microsoft Agent Framework, adds A2A + MCP interop for fleets of agents.
reference_frameworks.borrow_for: The citation/memory/tool-planning layers (src/harness/citations, memory, registry): planner and function-calling conventions, and A2A/MCP interop if the harness ever orchestrates multiple agents.

reference_frameworks.name: Dify
reference_frameworks.tagline: Build Agentic workflows, RAG pipelines, with rich AI model and tool support on one collaborative workspace.
reference_frameworks.author: LangGenius
reference_frameworks.category: LLM app platform / visual workflow + RAG builder
reference_frameworks.what_it_is: Self-hosted platform for building agent/workflow/chatflow apps visually, with RAG pipeline management, model management, and team collaboration — deployable on cloud, VPC, or self-hosted.
reference_frameworks.borrow_for: The 'product-grade' direction: a no-code workflow/agent builder and visual RAG pipeline layer if the harness evolves beyond a single-chat research console.
